listen.script: Teacher: Hello! What's your name? Lina: Hi! My name is Lina. I'm seven years old. I'm from Dammam. This is my brother, Fahad. He's nine. Teacher: Nice to meet you!
listen.cando: Can understand very short spoken descriptions of people and things.

listen.script: Sister: What's in your box? Brother: Look at my toys! This is my robot. It's big and grey. This is my ball. It's small and red. And this is my kite. It's yellow.
listen.cando: Can understand very short spoken descriptions of people and things.

listen.script: Teacher: Who's in your photo, Reem? Reem: This is my family. This is my mum, and this is my dad. This boy is my cousin, Saad. This woman is my aunt. She's very kind. And this baby is my sister.
listen.cando: Can understand very short spoken descriptions of people and things.

listen.script: Teacher: How many pencils, Omar? Omar: One, two, three, four, five, six. Six pencils! Teacher: Good. And how many books? Omar: Two books.

listen.script: Mum: Where's your cat, Hind? Hind: She's under the bed. Mum: And where's your ball? Hind: It's on the chair.

listen.script: Hind: Do you like apples, Sara? Sara: Yes, I do. I like apples and bananas. Hind: Do you like milk? Sara: No, I don't.
